title: Eleven pigeons, ten holes: the deepest trivial theorem
body: If more items than boxes, some box holds two items: the pigeonhole principle is nearly a tautology, yet it proves that in any group of 367 people two share a birthday is overkill, it proves points, hair-count collisions in cities, and key steps in hard theorems. Dirichlet wielded it so often it is also called the Dirichlet box principle.
